ios.desc:
Compress-san is the easiest way to compress videos on your iPhone or iPad. Just select a video from your photo library, and queue up your video for compression. Select up to 10 videos for compression at once and add them to the queue. In the application settings, you can choose your desired compression settings, compressing video to sizes as low as low quality 480p.

Compress-san also will use local on-device transcription models to create caption SRT files for your videos. Create subtitle text files locally and privately, with no audio or video leaving your device for creation of the SRTs. After an SRT is generated, you can also translate it into 23 different languages using local translation services. Compress-san is the simple and private way to cut your video sizes and create SRT subtitle transcription text files.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Compress-san, simple batch video compression and SRT subtitle creation

quotes.text:
Greetings all,

Just released a new iOS app called Compress-san. It's an easy-to-use utility to compress videos taken on iPhone, and then generate SRT files with transcriptions of any spoken word inside of the clip.

Had a friend who was creating work instructions and using videos to insert clips into the work instructions. This app allowed him to generate on-device subtitle SRT files to pass along into another LLM for creation of the general work instructions. He can then use the compressed video to create small video clips of key processes and throw on a shared drive.

Some additional nice features include batch processing of up to 10 videos at once, iPad UI support, local on-device translation of SRT files into 23 languages, and native support of the UI for Spanish and Japanese languages.

Welcome to any feedback or additional ideas.
